proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve the complete requested translation

**Severity:** `medium`

The translator guidance changes the requested phrase from `快速访问快速动作和模块切换` to `快速操作和模块切换`. That drops the "Fast access to" portion of the English resource and differs from the correction explicitly documented in issue 50172, so the generated Simplified Chinese resource would not implement the reported fix. Keep the complete expected phrase in the guidance.

```suggestion
    <comment>Simplified Chinese: translate the full string as "快速访问快速动作和模块切换", not "快速访问快速作和模块切换".</comment>
```
